name: SEOJuice
author: Vadim Kravcenko

sections.description:
SEOJuice Integration is a simple yet powerful plugin that adds on-page optimizations to your WordPress site. By integrating SEOJuice’s JavaScript snippet, you can enhance your content’s SEO performance with minimal effort.

Key Features:
* Automated On-Page SEO
* Automated Internal Links
* Alt text optimizations
* No configuration needed – works out of the box (with SEOJuice account)
* Lightweight and optimized for performance
* Compatible with all themes and major plugins

Installation and Setup

  1. Sign up for a SEOJuice account at https://seojuice.io
  2. Upload the seojuice folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. That’s it! The SEOJuice script will now be loaded from cdn.seojuice.io on all your pages.
  5. Your improvements are added based on the domain where the JS snippet is loaded from.

Once configured, SEOJuice will automatically:
– Analyze your content for SEO improvements and internal linking opportunities
– Add alt text optimizations for images based on the page and the image content
– You will receively weekly technical SEO audit emails.

External Services

This plugin connects to SEOJuice’s content optimization service (cdn.seojuice.io and seojuice.io) to provide SEO improvements.

Data Collection:
– Page content is analyzed via crawlers.
– No personal data is collected.

This service is provided by SEOJuice:
– Terms of Service: https://seojuice.io/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://seojuice.io/privacy-policy/

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to SEOJuice’s servers to provide SEO optimization suggestions. See our privacy policy at https://seojuice.io/data-processing-agreement/ for details on data handling.
sections.faq:
Do I need a SEOJuice account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active SEOJuice account to benefit from the content suggestions. Sign up at https://seojuice.io.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No, the plugin is designed to be lightweight. It only adds a small script to your site’s footer, which is loaded asynchronously and doesn’t block your page rendering.

Is this plugin compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, this plugin is compatible with most caching plugins. The SEOJuice script is loaded dynamically and works correctly with cached pages.

What happens to the added links if my subscription expires?

All optimizations and links added by SEOJuice are only active while you have a valid subscription. When your subscription expires, the optimizations will no longer be applied to your pages. However, you can export your optimization data at any time. The optimizations will return automatically when you reactivate your subscription.

Does SEOJuice make direct changes to my database?

No, SEOJuice does not make any direct changes to your WordPress database. All optimizations are applied through our JavaScript snippet which modifies the page content dynamically when it loads. This means your original content remains untouched in the database, making it completely safe to deactivate the plugin at any time.
